summary_zh: 这是面向 AI 编程代理的开源 Agent Skills 集合，包含网页设计、视频演示、代码短片、图像生成、文章美化与本地知识检索等技能，可按 README 提供的安装方式引入使用。
audience_zh: 适合使用 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等 AI 编程代理，并希望借助现成技能完成前端设计、演示视频、图像生成或知识检索的开发者和创作者。

evidence.quote: ConardLi's open-source Skills collection, featuring web design, knowledge retrieval, image generation, and more.
**A curated collection of production-ready [Agent Skills](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512176-what-are-skills) for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other AI coding agents.**

**Best for:** showreels, product films, UI motion, kinetic typography, logo/title sequences, generative loops, retrospectives and narrated explainers. Short pieces typically run 5–60 s; chapter-based films support up to 20 minutes.

`motion-showreel` delivers MP4 plus editable source. It confirms the topic, duration, orientation, independent music/SFX sources and narration mode, then writes a brief and confirms style frames.
